practice.title: Practise creating your first post
practice.safety: Everything here is a simulation. Inputs are fixed. No files are uploaded, no AI credits are used, and nothing is published or saved to your business.
practice.photoNote: Fixed sample photos. These are not your products or a live fidelity check.
practice.brief: Introduce the sample serum with a simple everyday routine. Do not add prices or unverified claims.
practice.errorBody: This is a simulated error. In the real app, check Activity, then retry. Your product details remain saved.
practice.reviewBody: Browse the sample slides and pick one of the two fixed captions. No model runs in this exercise.
practice.caption0: Meet LUMI, a simple addition to your daily routine.
practice.caption1: Make a little time for your daily routine with LUMI.
practice.shareBody: Both destinations below are simulated. Choosing Facebook here does not enable Facebook publishing in the real app.
practice.completeBody: You reviewed the product, chose a caption and approved a simulated post. Real posting requires a connected account and explicit approval.
tour.menuBody: Take a guided tour of this page, or practise with a fixed sample product.
tour.title: Page tutorial
tour.today: Today shows the current post and its real status. Review the images and caption before approving.
tour.carousel: Browse each slide. Check the product photo and any text before continuing.
tour.caption: Choose a suggested caption or edit it. Your selection is carried into the approval step.
tour.approve: This opens the sharing step. Publishing still needs your explicit approval; the tutorial never presses this button.
tour.products: Keep your product photos and confirmed details here.
tour.addProduct: Start here to add a real product. This tutorial does not open the picker or upload anything.
tour.productPhoto: Check the original photo and extracted cutout. Only confirm it when the product looks correct.
tour.results: Results is where post performance belongs. Unavailable metrics are shown as empty, not invented numbers.
tour.resultsData: Use the available result details to review performance. Live metric integration is not complete yet.
tour.settings: Manage company details, writing style, social connections and your account here.
tour.company: Keep company information accurate so future content uses the right context.
tour.voice: Set your preferred tone and writing rules for generated captions.
tour.social: Connect your publishing account here. Signing in with Meta is separate from granting publishing access.
tour.account: Manage account preferences and privacy. This tour does not change them.
tour.activity: Activity explains how the current post was created.
tour.activityDetails: Inspect recorded steps, model calls, timing, cost and failures. During an active job this data refreshes.
tour.navigation: Use these links to switch between Today, Products, Results, Settings and Activity. The question-mark button stays available.
tour.onboarding: Complete setup in order. Your saved details prepare the app for your first post.
tour.onboardingInput: Enter or confirm the information for this step. The tour explains controls without submitting them.
tour.practice: This is a separate practice session with fixed sample data. It cannot publish, upload or change your real account.
tour.practiceProduct: Browse the supplied sample slides. You cannot replace these with real files.
tour.practiceActions: Follow these steps, select preset options and simulate approval. Restart whenever you want.

bk.body: Colours, fonts and style Marken uses on every post. You can change them any time.
bk.needDescription: Add a company description in step 1 to fill this in automatically.
bk.filled: Suggested from your description. Change anything you like.
bk.colorsHint: Up to 5. Text uses the first colour that stays easy to read on the picture.
bk.guidancePlaceholder: e.g. Warm and handmade. Plenty of space around the product.
